thread:
Amanda S: Heads-up: DSAR from BetaPartner asking for erasure of chat transcripts + derived embeddings. Some transcripts were processed with a customer-owned KMS (cross-account) and stored in s3:partner-us-east-1. Ticket BP-DSR-9001. Also there's an open vuln ticket (VULN-900) that flagged the same partition. Need to align RBAC + forensic requirements.

security-bot: New DSAR created: BP-DSR-9001. Tags: cross-account-kms, dsar, legal-flag. Assigned: #eng-security.

Dinesh P: Quick note: cross-account KMS means we don't have key-admin rights. We can request a restricted Decrypt grant from the partner OR ask them to produce a sealed export. Which route do we prefer?

Noor A: If partner can grant a one-off Grant with an External ID and limited operations (Decrypt only for specified ciphertexts) that's ideal. Otherwise we can do a re-encryption flow: partner exports ciphertext blobs -> partner wraps with partner-key -> partner uploads to our forensics bucket encrypted with our key. But that requires partner cooperation.

Priya K: Legal: we must not move data out of partner-controlled keyspace without an agreement. Partner consent required for any rewrap. Also if VULN-900 is under investigation, legal hold may apply. We need to confirm hold scope (all BetaPartner data or only service-internal artifacts).

Amanda S: Operational ask: can we carve out a minimal RBAC window that doesn't give long-term key access? Proposal: partner issues KMS Grant for our dsar-service-principal with session constraints (time-limited + ciphertext list). That would avoid us requesting key admin.

Dinesh P: Technically supported. KMS Grant API supports operations and retire-on-delete semantics. We should request: Encrypt=0, Decrypt=1, CreateGrant=false, RetireGrantAllowed=false, GrantTokens optional. Also recommend ephemeral STS session and a Canary object to validate grant mapping.

Noor A: Add logging requirement: partner must enable CloudTrail logs for KMS:Decrypt and share proof of those logs for the grant duration. Otherwise we lack independent audit.

Priya K: Legal agrees to conditional approach IF: (1) partner signs a limited scoping addendum (doc snippet provided), (2) we log all operations and share audit evidence in sealed manifest, (3) snapshot retention max 60 days, (4) we produce proof-of-erasure for subject.

security-bot: Alert: VULN-900 currently marked "investigating" and tagged "potential-evidence". Admins requested to avoid destructive ops until forensic snapshot captured.

Amanda S: OK. Plan A (preferred): partner issues KMS Grant -> we run dsar-erasure job with preflight snapshot and audit hooks. Plan B (if partner declines): request sealed export & rewrap. If neither possible, we escalate to Privacy Escalation with GC.

Dinesh P: Implementation details: we need a one-time terraform snippet? partner will provide GrantId and allowed ciphertext ARNs. We will create a local IAM role dsar-temp which can assume with ExternalID. Also add a one-time policy limiting calls to kms:Decrypt on provided key_arn and kms:GenerateDataKey for rewrap if partner allows.

Noor A: Preflight steps:
1) Verify ciphertext list from partner matches items in s3 prefix (hash check).
2) Partner posts CloudTrail export for the KMS key for the last 7 days.
3) We create a forensics bucket (WORM), write snapshot, record SHA256 manifest.
4) Acquire explicit legal sealed snapshot ARN before erase.

Amanda S: Verification after deletion: run vector search using internal-indexer-scan and produce a signed report: count of hits before/after, list of deleted embedding_ids, and attest to inability to resolve transcript text from remaining embeddings. Must include who executed the job and IAM role session IDs.

Priya K: Legal also requests that any access to partner keys for this operation be limited to security-bot + dsar-service principal; developer accounts must be excluded. We also require an audit email to legal@beta-partner and legal@redwood immediately after operation.

infra-bot: Note: scheduled job will rotate network credentials for dsar-temp role expiry. Recommend 15-minute grace window and automated revoke via EventBridge rule.

Dinesh P: Edge case: what if partner Grant later gets revoked and we need to prove deletion after they revoke logs? We'll capture CloudTrail export and notarize it into our evidence store before relying on it. Also timestamped manifests and signed attestations help.

Noor A: Another edge case: embeddings may exist in cold backups or long-term snapshots. We must enumerate backup catalogs and mark any matching objects for deletion or exemption. I've started a query: `SELECT storage_uri FROM backup_catalog WHERE customer_id='beta-partner'` and will share results.

Amanda S: Good. Also add a retention exception record in case we cannot fully purge due to legal hold; record reason, owners, and next review date. But aim for full purge.

Priya K: Legal is OK to proceed with Plan A if partner signs addendum and posts the Grant + CloudTrail proof. Keep sealed snapshot retention <= 60d. We'll generate a templated subject response.

security-bot: EXC-DSR-BP-01 created pending partner confirmation.

Dinesh P: I'll draft the terraform snippet and a minimal runbook (preflight checklist, revoke timers, verification commands). PR to infra will reference BP-DSR-9001.

Amanda S: Thanks. @Noor A please paste backup catalog results once you have them, and @Priya K please post the addendum template. We'll wait on partner confirmation before kicking off.

legal-bot: BP-DSR-9001: legal addendum template posted to ticket.

Amanda S: Closing loop for now — will update ticket with planned timeline.
